messages:
Jordan (oncall): hey team — quick clarification for this weekend's handoff. i'm primary for sat 00:00-08:00 UTC, priya can cover 08:00-16:00 UTC, but we still have a gap around 02:30-04:30 UTC where we don't have an explicit secondary. can someone confirm coverage or swap?
Priya (secondary): i can slide earlier by 2 hours but need someone to take the late slot on sunday morning. not ideal but doable for this week.
Mateo (SRE Lead): quick question — is the gap purely a scheduling hole or are we short on qualified rotators? we need someone who can handle infra and model routing fallbacks.
Jordan (oncall): scheduling hole. our current on-call rota has no one listed for that 02:30-04:30 UTC slice. i can stay longer but would prefer not to burn OT every weekend.
Sam (support): if primary/secondary overlap is missing we should also set temporary escalation policy so support knows who to page. right now support pages primary, then primary's pager. we need a fallback.
incident-bot: incident digest: no active Sev1s. Active Sev2: #1769983 - degraded embeddings throughput (mitigation in progress). See /incidents/1769983 for details.
Leah (product): customer-impact note — a couple of freemium customers in eu reported higher latencies overnight. we should include that in any SLO communication if it overlaps with the gap.
Priya (secondary): ok i can start at 06:00 UTC instead and Jordan can cover 00:00-06:00, that moves the gap to 03:30-04:30 only. still a gap but smaller.
Mateo (SRE Lead): temporary escalation policy proposal (we should tweet this into runbook slack):
```
Severity -> Who to page first -> If no ack in 10m -> Escalate to
SEV1 (prod down / data loss) -> Primary oncall -> Pager: SRE Lead -> Escalate to Eng Director
SEV2 (degraded / major feature impact) -> Primary oncall -> If no response 10m -> Secondary -> If still no response 20m -> SRE Lead
SEV3 (minor issues / cosmetic) -> Message @eng-oncall channel -> Oncall at-will response
```
Jordan (oncall): that's good. can we make the secondary auto-notify support-manager if the primary doesn't acknowledge in 10m? support often pages only primary.
Sam (support): yes please. otherwise we get lag. add a step: after 10m, notify support-manager and ping the oncall slack channel with a follow-up template.
Mateo (SRE Lead): agreed. i'll update the runbook and push a short snippet to the ops-runbook repo. below is the recommended paging template for support -> oncall handoff:
```
Subject: URGENT: [SEV{1|2}] {short issue summary}
Body:
- Impact: {customers affected, percentage, regions}
- Start time: {ISO ts}
- Observable: {error rates, latency p95, logs snippet}
- Attempts: {what support tried}
- Contact: {customer contact + support rep}
```
Priya (secondary): small nit — for model routing fallbacks, please include the command to trigger the manual fallback. otherwise the oncall has to dig around.
Jordan (oncall): good point. paste the command here?
Mateo (SRE Lead): manual fallback snippet for routing service (internal):
```bash
# run on routing-prod-01
curl -X POST "https://internal-api.redwood.local/v1/admin/fallback" \ 
 -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \ 
 -d '{"model_variant": "gptq-4x-fallback", "reason": "latency spike"}'
```
Sam (support): also, for customer-facing comms, we need a simple "we're investigating" template and a separate "service restored" template. we should centralize them in "/docs/incident-templates".
Leah (product): i'll maintain the customer templates and ensure legal approved wording. ping me on the thread when you put drafts.
Jordan (oncall): another ask — what exactly constitutes a page to eng directors? our current rule is only for SEV1 but there were near-SEV1s that would benefit from early director involvement. can we add a threshold (e.g., sustained >5m error rate at >5% of requests)?
Mateo (SRE Lead): propose: if degradation is trending to potential SEV1 (error rate >5% AND sustained for 5m OR p95 latency >3s for 5m) -> page SRE Lead and optionally Eng Director. we'll make Eng Director optional with a checkbox during the page flow.
Priya (secondary): can we add a short checklist to the handoff message so whoever takes the late slot knows where to start? e.g., prefix cache warm, check routing queues, check instance health, look at KV cache hit rate.
Jordan (oncall): yes — handoff checklist idea: 1) confirm no active Sev1/2, 2) check /dashboards/oncall-summary for latency trends, 3) rotate keys if any deploys are scheduled, 4) ensure runbook pinned in channel.
Mateo (SRE Lead): i'll add a minimal checklist to the oncall rota page and include a link in the auto-handoff message that incident-bot posts at shift change.
incident-bot: scheduling note: Jordan's shift extended 00:00-06:00 UTC, Priya 06:00-16:00 UTC. Temporary gap 03:30-04:30 UTC flagged. Please confirm a volunteer or assign someone as "late-stretch".
Sam (support): volunteer: i can be late-stretch for 1 weekend but only to triage customer comms, not perform infra fixes. (+1 team)
Priya (secondary): thanks sam. can we set policy: "late-stretch" means triage + escalate, not necessarily run manual fallbacks unless SRE leads authorize.
Jordan (oncall): ok setting expectation. Mateo can authorize fallbacks if needed.
Mateo (SRE Lead): i'll be reachable for fallbacks if you need me during the late-stretch window. i'll also add my cell to the emergency pager for that slot.
Leah (product): any change to paging rules should be communicated to support and account teams. i'll coordinate a short note to customer success.
Jordan (oncall): sweet. action items: Mateo updates runbook & paging matrix; Mateo adds fallback command to runbook; incident-bot will post auto-handoff; Sam is late-stretch for this weekend for comms only; Priya slides start to 06:00; Jordan covers 00:00-06:00. i'll follow up in the rota calendar. thanks all :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: deploy queued: ops/runbook@main -> v1.2.3 (no downtime)
Mateo (SRE Lead): thanks — i'll get the runbook PR in within the hour and add the checklist. Jordan, tag me if the gap changes and we need a different coverage plan.
Jordan (oncall): will do. closing this thread after rota updated.
